'''Rumahn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was the first [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] aboard ''[[Leveler]]'', serving directly under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
